#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Add external review receipts and commit the evidence-only c07 successor locally."""
from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,time
R=Path("/workspace/scratch/chain-pq-root-recovery-20261106-v1")
G=R/"chain-compose"; C=R/"publication-control"
CODE="c07e8b9cce4621c5ef6f61256482bfe94e5a622f"
def sha(b):return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()
def git(*a):return subprocess.check_output(["git",*a],cwd=G)
def save(p,v):
    with p.open("x") as f:f.write(json.dumps(v,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+"\n")
commands=[]
def run(label,argv):
    p=subprocess.run(argv,cwd=G,capture_output=True)
    (C/(label+".stdout.log")).write_bytes(p.stdout);(C/(label+".stderr.log")).write_bytes(p.stderr)
    commands.append({"label":label,"argv":argv,"exit_code":p.returncode,"stdout_sha256":sha(p.stdout),"stderr_sha256":sha(p.stderr)})
    save(C/(label+".execution.json"),commands[-1])
    assert p.returncode==0,(label,p.stderr.decode())
    return p
def main():
    assert git("rev-parse","HEAD").decode().strip()==CODE
    fixed={"docs/development/TRNM_AI_NATIVE_BLOCKCHAIN_DEVELOPMENT_PLAN.md","evidence/pq-integration-20261106/README.md","evidence/pq-integration-20261106/qualification.json","evidence/pq-integration-20261106/source-publication-map.json"}
    assert set(git("diff","--name-only").decode().splitlines())==fixed
    run("pre-supplement-preflight",["bash","scripts/project-preflight.sh"])
    source=R/"integration-review/final-increment-independent-review-v1"
    h=(source/"handoff.json").read_bytes();assert sha(h)=="471b90f48d62180552386444cfe7d8bb8c79d9728c52ca555b046b63da4b5ebb"
    handoff=json.loads(h); assert handoff["state"]=="COMPLETED_INDEPENDENT_READBACK_INTEGRITY_ONLY"
    assert handoff["native_status_counts_preserved"]=={"blocked":2,"failed":1,"succeeded":74}
    assert handoff["manifest_bindings_verified"]==855 and handoff["archive_members_verified"]==971
    target=G/"evidence/pq-integration-20261106/witness/review-supplement";target.mkdir()
    records=[]
    def cp(src,dst,expected=None):
        b=src.read_bytes()
        if expected:assert len(b)==expected["bytes"] and sha(b)==expected["sha256"]
        dst.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
        with dst.open("xb") as f:f.write(b)
        assert dst.read_bytes()==b and src.read_bytes()==b
        records.append({"source":src.relative_to(R).as_posix(),"path":dst.relative_to(target).as_posix(),"bytes":len(b),"sha256":sha(b)})
    for row in handoff["files"]:
        p=Path(row["path"]);rel=p.relative_to(source);cp(p,target/"independent-review"/rel,row)
    for name in ("handoff.json","manifest.json"):cp(source/name,target/"independent-review"/name)
    for name in ("selection.execution.json","selection.stdout.log","selection.stderr.log","scan.execution.json","scan.stdout.log","scan.stderr.log","sensitive-pattern-review.json","collection.execution.json","collection.stdout.log","collection.stderr.log"):
        cp(C/name,target/name)
    cp(C/"review-supplement-README.md",target/"README.md")
    save(target/"supplement-files.json",{"schema":"trnm-c07-publication-review-supplement-v1","source":CODE,"files":records,"self_included":False,"project_or_native_executed":False,"original_native_status_counts":{"succeeded":74,"failed":1,"blocked":2},"whole_chain_pq_qualified":False})
    run("stage-publication",["git","add","--",*sorted(fixed),"evidence/pq-integration-20261106/witness"])
    changes=git("diff","--cached","--name-status","--no-renames","-z").decode().split("\0")[:-1];assert len(changes)%2==0
    seen=set()
    for status,path in zip(changes[::2],changes[1::2]):
        assert (status=="M" and path in fixed) or (status=="A" and path.startswith("evidence/pq-integration-20261106/witness/")),(status,path)
        if status=="M":seen.add(path)
    assert seen==fixed
    run("staged-diff-check",["git","diff","--cached","--check"])
    run("precommit-staged-preflight",["bash","scripts/project-preflight.sh","--staged"])
    message="docs: publish c07 PQ witness and release terminal evidence\n\nPreserve native exit 1 (74 succeeded, one failed, two blocked), original budgets,\nindependent raw readbacks and whole-chain HOLD. Keep prior evidence unchanged."
    (C/"publication-commit-message.txt").write_text(message+"\n")
    run("local-publication-commit",["git","-c","user.name=Codex","-c","user.email=codex@openai.com","commit","-F",str(C/"publication-commit-message.txt")])
    head=git("rev-parse","HEAD").decode().strip();tree=git("rev-parse","HEAD^{tree}").decode().strip()
    assert git("show","-s","--format=%P","HEAD").decode().strip()==CODE and git("status","--porcelain=v1")==b""
    (C/"local-publication-commit.raw.txt").write_bytes(git("cat-file","commit",head))
    rows=[]
    for status,path in zip(changes[::2],changes[1::2]):
        b=(G/path).read_bytes(); blob=hashlib.sha1(b"blob "+str(len(b)).encode()+b"\0"+b).hexdigest()
        assert git("rev-parse",head+":"+path).decode().strip()==blob
        assert git("cat-file","blob",blob)==b
        rows.append({"status":status,"path":path,"mode":"100644","type":"blob","git_blob":blob,"bytes":len(b),"sha256":sha(b),"absolute_path":str(G/path)})
    plan={"schema":"trnm-c07-evidence-publication-github-plan-v1","local_commit":head,"tree":tree,"ordered_parents":[CODE],"message":message,"files":rows,"changed_files":len(rows),"changed_bytes":sum(r["bytes"] for r in rows),"native_execution_on_publication":False,"public_refs_moved":False}
    save(C/"final-github-publication-plan.json",plan)
    save(C/"finish-publication-local.receipt.json",{"local_commit":head,"tree":tree,"parent":CODE,"commands":commands,"supplement_files":len(records)+1,"publication_files":len(rows),"clean":True,"public_refs_moved":False,"native_executed":False})
    print(json.dumps({k:plan[k] for k in ("local_commit","tree","ordered_parents","changed_files","changed_bytes","public_refs_moved")}))
if __name__=="__main__":main()

# Independent publication evidence readbacks

This supplement records integrity and content checks for the c07 witness and
release-root evidence increment. The actual code source is
`c07e8b9cce4621c5ef6f61256482bfe94e5a622f`; the native batch remains exit 1,
with 74 succeeded, one failed and two blocked observations.

The [archive index](../publication/archive-index.json) binds 971 members:
966 selected original files and five generated metadata files. The archive
contains the complete current raw terminal records, independent readbacks,
V6 reports, preserved intermediate failures and explicit recovery provenance.
Its hash-only checks do not execute the evidence or qualify the product.

The selection, finite-pattern scan and collection execution receipts retain
their actual commands, outputs and exit codes. The scan covers exactly 966
selected text files and four fixed credential/PEM/signed-URL patterns. Its
zero findings establish only that bounded result.

The independent archive review is kept in `independent-review/` with its
method, actual execution and explicit handoff. It rechecks member identities,
declared manifest bindings and preservation of the failed native and historical
observations. It does not rerun source gates, Cargo, native controls or old CI.

`supplement-files.json` binds this supplement's files, excluding itself.
The containing publication's seven source-only gates are executed after its
immutable commit exists; their separate actual commit and records are linked
from the maintained section of PR #723. Those gates never convert c07's failed
native batch into a pass. The PR remains Draft / HOLD.
